name: CRIBROT
author: strings-agent
description: EASY. Caesar cipher with a crib. Clue is 'CIPHERTEXT|CRIB': the ciphertext is 3-4 concatenated English words (no spaces) rotated by a shift 1..25, and CRIB is one of those plaintext words (>=4 letters). Solution: the plaintext. The scorer only checks that (a) the answer has the same length and is all lowercase letters, (b) every character differs from the ciphertext by the SAME amount mod 26 (i.e. it is some rotation), and (c) the crib occurs in it. generate rejects any instance where more than one of the 26 rotations contains the crib, so the answer is unique and the scorer stays tiny. Discovery path: one demo shows readable English against a garbled clue, and the crib after the '|' appears verbatim in the answer -> 'Caesar, and here is the check'. Even without spotting English, brute-forcing 26 shifts for the crib solves it, which is exactly the intended fallback. Solve is ~0.05 ms.
